methodologyNotes: Prices in USD MSRP from manufacturer or authorized retailer at time of verification. Sale prices excluded (MSRP tracked). Accuracy reported as manufacturer-stated typical accuracy at normal operating range. Certification claims (UL, ETL, cETLus) verified against manufacturer documentation and NRTL records. Products discontinued by manufacturer with no legitimate new-sale channel rejected. specKeys use null where manufacturer does not publish a value.
